ruleset.name: Mandatory declarations on pre-packaged commodities
ruleset.rule: Rule 6 — Declarations to be made on every package
ruleset.status: draft — clause references pending verification against the consolidated Rules
ruleset.note: Rule 6(1) requires every package to bear a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration of the items below. This file encodes presence and format checks only. Legibility, prominence and letter-height are governed by Rule 9 and are out of scope for v1 (see roadmap).

declarations.label: Name and complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
extraction_hints: Commonly follows 'Manufactured by', 'Marketed by', 'Packed by', 'Imported by'
Address block usually spans multiple lines and ends with a PIN code
declarations.fail_message: Name and complete address of manufacturer, packer or importer not declared

declarations.label: Common or generic name of the commodity
extraction_hints: Distinct from the brand name — e.g. brand 'Parle-G', generic name 'Biscuits'
declarations.fail_message: Common or generic name of the commodity not declared

declarations.label: Net quantity in standard units
extraction_hints: Preceded by 'Net Qty', 'Net Weight', 'Net Vol' or stated bare
SI units expected: g, kg, ml, l, or a count 'N'
declarations.fail_message: Net quantity not declared, not in a prescribed unit, or qualified by a prohibited expression

declarations.label: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed
exemptions: Spare parts and accessories supplied under warranty and not intended for sale to end customers (w.e.f. 1 April 2024)
extraction_hints: Preceded by 'Mfg', 'Mfd', 'MFG DATE', 'Packed on', 'Date of manufacture'
Month-year granularity is sufficient; full date is common but not required
For electronic products the declaration must be clearly visible on the retail package
declarations.fail_message: Month and year of manufacture or packing not declared

declarations.label: Retail sale price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes
declarations.fail_message: Retail sale price not declared, or not stated as inclusive of all taxes

declarations.label: Consumer care details — name, address, telephone and email of the person to be contacted
extraction_hints: Preceded by 'Customer Care', 'Consumer Care', 'For queries contact'
Frequently absent on small and unbranded packaging — a common violation

declarations.label: Country of origin
extraction_hints: Preceded by 'Country of Origin', 'Made in', 'Product of'
Applies to imported packages only — do not flag on domestic packages
declarations.fail_message: Country of origin not declared on an imported package

declarations.label: Unit sale price
exemptions: Not required where the retail sale price equals the unit sale price (second proviso to Rule 6(11))
Not required for combination packages, group packages or multi-piece packages
extraction_hints: Expressed per standard unit, e.g. '₹40 per 100 g'
declarations.fail_message: Unit sale price not declared and no exemption applies

scope_exemptions.note: Chapter II provisions do not apply to the following. Packages matching these are marked OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than non-compliant.
rules: Packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litres
Cement, fertiliser and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg
Packages of 10 g or 10 ml or less
Drugs covered under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act
Fast food items packed by a restaurant or hotel

ecommerce_mode.note: E-commerce entities must display the Rule 6(1) declarations on the digital platform, except the month and year of manufacture. Unit sale price is not required on e-commerce listings.

roadmap_out_of_scope_v1.why_deferred: Requires assessment of contrast and placement, not just presence
Requires real-world scale calibration from a photograph

roadmap_out_of_scope_v1.item: Detection of altered or overprinted date markings
roadmap_out_of_scope_v1.why_deferred: Flag for manual inspection only; never auto-reject
